description: Read the authenticated business’s bookable calendar services, resources and host timezone, or check available times on one local date. Omit date/service/resource to discover options first; then provide both date and the exact service name, with an optional returned resource. Availability includes the host’s configured schedule, existing reservations and connected calendar busy periods. Times are a snapshot, never a reservation: prepare_meeting_link checks again and atomically reserves before creating a room, while visitors to prepare_booking_link choose and reserve later. Use list_meetings/get_meeting to find existing rooms separately. Read only; creates no room, booking, invite or email. Requires the owned calendar service; never assume a timezone or invent a service name.
name: get_meeting_availability
